messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@shopflo.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 15-minute infra check before demo?

Hi Priyom,

We signed up via the self-serve flow last night (thanks — your onboarding flow is great). Before we book a full product walkthrough, our infra/ops lead would like a short 15-minute technical screen to confirm compatibility with our stack and to make sure we can meet latency targets. High-level:

- Company: ShopFlo (retail personalization)
- Cluster: Managed K8s on GKE, nodes are A100s for training but inference will probably run on T4s/NV6 in GA cloud initially
- Models: experimenting with Llama2-70B and some fine-tuned variants (we may quantize)
- Target: <=120ms p95 for 256-token responses; bursty traffic (spikes during marketing pushes)
- Integration: leaning private VPC deployment, want to understand data residency and KMS options

I attached a one-page architecture diagram (shopflo-arch-diagram.pdf) — it’s not exhaustive but should help. Can someone from your side do a short technical triage tomorrow or early next week? We’re West Coast (PST).

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of ML Ops, ShopFlo
alex.turner@shopflo.com

Attachment: shopflo-arch-diagram.pdf (PDF, 450KB)

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 15-minute infra check before demo?

Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the diagram. Happy to do a short triage call; that’s exactly the kind of question our SEs like to handle up front. Short logistics:

- Proposed 15-min windows (PST): Mon 11/06 10:00–10:15, Mon 11/06 15:00–15:15, Tue 11/07 09:00–09:15. Which works best?
- Can you confirm expected peak RPS and typical context length distribution? Helpful but not required for the triage.
- You mentioned private VPC — is GCP VPC peering or on-prem via VPN what you’re considering? Also please confirm if you need BYOK (we support KMS + HSM for Private installs).

I’ve CC’d Dev (SE) who will join the call for the deeper infra stuff. We’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot. If you prefer, we can do a short async review first — we can also ask you to drop a sanitized test prompt set into the Drive link below.

Quick agenda for 15 min (we’ll keep it tight):
1) confirm model + sequence length profile
2) routing & deployment preference (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
3) any hard SLOs / compliance needs to call out

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference

Thanks — 11/06 15:00 PST works for us. Peak RPS during campaigns is roughly 180 requests/sec for short burst windows (few minutes). Typical context length is 120–300 tokens depending on personalization payload; we’d likely quantize smaller models for cost.

We’ll do GCP VPC peering for the Private path and will need KMS integration (BYOK). I can share a sanitized sample payload ahead of the call — I’ll upload to your Drive link (expect that by EOD Monday).

One last ask: can you include the Account Exec on the invite so we can also talk contract/timeline if the triage looks good?

— Alex
